# NoliLab

> NoliLab makes the **Loko GPS Tracker** — the world's smallest offline GPS device (28.5 × 20.5 × 5.9 mm, 14 g). It works without SIM cards or cellular networks using direct LoRa P2P radio with 20+ km line-of-sight range and up to 12 months battery life. No subscription, no monthly fees, no cloud account required. All tracking data stays on the user's device. Open-source firmware. Made by Nolilab OÜ, Tallinn, Estonia. Starting at $59.

Last updated: 2026-08-10

## Key Facts

- **Technology:** LoRa P2P radio (peer-to-peer, no gateway needed) + optional LoRaWAN Class A
- **Range:** 20+ km line-of-sight
- **Size:** 28.5 × 20.5 × 5.9 mm — smallest GPS tracker in its class
- **Weight:** 14 g (0.5 oz)
- **Battery:** 200 mAh Li-ion, USB-C charging (~60 min), 30 days to 12 months depending on update interval
- **GNSS:** GPS + GLONASS + Galileo + BeiDou, 2.5 m CEP accuracy, 72-channel receiver
- **Frequencies:** 868 MHz (EU) / 915 MHz (US) / 923 MHz (AS)
- **Data logger:** 6,500 GPS points stored on-device
- **Multi-tracking:** Up to 30 simultaneous trackers per ground station
- **App:** iOS, Android, LineageOS — with offline maps and geofencing
- **Desktop:** Free configuration tool for macOS, Windows, Linux
- **Certifications:** CE, FCC Part 15, RoHS, REACH; LoRaWAN v1.0.3
- **Privacy:** Zero data collection — no cloud, no accounts, no tracking cookies
- **Firmware:** Open-source, free updates for the life of the device

## Products & Pricing

- **Loko Air** — $59: One Air unit (the tracker attached to the asset). For expanding an existing system, or pairing with a Ground unit you already own.
- **Loko Bundle** — $119: One Air unit (tracker) + one Loko Ground receiver. This is the complete system and the right choice for new users.

The Air unit is the GPS tracker attached to the asset being tracked. The Ground unit is the LoRa receiver connected to the mobile app that displays positions. Hardware is manufactured and sold through Seeed Studio.

## Use Cases

Loko is used for: drones and FPV aircraft, pets and livestock, farm equipment, fleet management, outdoor adventures (hiking, cycling, skiing), search and rescue, wildlife research, valuables, and any asset in areas without cellular coverage.

- [LoRa GPS Tracker](https://www.nolilab.com/lora-gps-tracker/): The main product guide — how LoRa P2P tracking works, terrain-by-terrain range figures, comparison against cellular and satellite trackers, and setup overview.
- [Specifications](https://www.nolilab.com/specifications/): Complete technical specifications — dimensions, weight, GNSS constellations, LoRa parameters, battery, power consumption, environmental ratings, certifications, and product comparison table.
- [How Loko Works](https://www.nolilab.com/how-gps-works/): How the tracker determines and transmits position without internet or cell service.
- [Battery Life](https://www.nolilab.com/battery-life/): Battery life by update interval, what drives consumption, and how Loko compares to cellular trackers.
- [Smallest GPS Tracker](https://www.nolilab.com/smallest-gps-tracker/): Size and weight comparison against other GPS trackers.
- [Software & App](https://www.nolilab.com/software/): Download the Loko mobile app for iOS, Android, and LineageOS. Also the free desktop configuration tool for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- [Firmware upgrade guide](https://www.nolilab.com/blog/how-to-upgrade-loko-firmware/): How to upgrade Loko open-source firmware. Loko Air updates via the browser-based STM32 updater; Loko Ground flashes over USB-C from the Loko Config Tool.
- [Setup Guides](https://www.nolilab.com/setup-guides/): Step-by-step instructions for configuring the Air and Ground units, pairing the mobile app, and starting offline GPS tracking.
- [LoRaWAN](https://www.nolilab.com/lorawan/): How to connect Loko to The Things Network (TTN) and other LoRaWAN gateways for IoT integration.
- [LoRaWAN with ChirpStack](https://www.nolilab.com/chirpstack/): How to connect Loko to a self-hosted ChirpStack LoRaWAN network server — gateway, device profile with Cayenne LPP, application, OTAA device join, and measurement gauges.
- [3D-Printed Accessories](https://www.nolilab.com/accessories/): Free CAD files for 3D-printable Loko accessories — collar mounts, drone mounts, belt clips and stands, with suggested print settings.
- [Open Source](https://www.nolilab.com/open-source/): Schematics, PCB files, and firmware source published on GitHub.
- [GPS & LoRa Technology](https://www.nolilab.com/gps/): Educational guide covering GPS/GNSS fundamentals, LoRa radio, LoRa P2P vs LoRaWAN, radio line-of-sight, and ionospheric effects on signal quality.
- [Blog](https://www.nolilab.com/blog/): Technical articles and guides on Loko, LoRa technology, drone tracking, farm equipment GPS, fleet management, and outdoor use cases.
- [About the author](https://www.nolilab.com/author/tamleykha-piriyev/): Tamleykha Piriyev — author of the technical guides on this site.
- [Contact](https://www.nolilab.com/contact/): Support and sales inquiries — email akio@nolilab.com. Nolilab OÜ, K. A. Hermanni tn 2-9, Tallinn 10115, Estonia.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nolilab.com/privacy/): Zero data collection policy — all tracking data stays on the user's device with no cloud storage, no accounts required, and no tracking cookies.

The full URL list is in [sitemap.xml](https://www.nolilab.com/sitemap.xml).
